==About==

Crafting {{i|Corn Pudding}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Corn Pudding}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Corn Pudding. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead. Corn Pudding is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Bread}} Food Group.
